errors.text_span: a donut chart with two concentric rings, illustrating the distribution of samples (%) across different values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation (outer ring) and sample-level maximum ambiguity (inner ring)
errors.evidence: The chart is a single donut chart where each segment is dual-coded by color (the outer part of the segment corresponds to 'Ambiguity Std' and the inner part corresponds to 'Max Ambiguity'). It is not two separate, independently segmented concentric rings.

errors.text_span: The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)", is divided into four segments
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows six segments, not four. While the legend for 'Ambiguity Std' has four categories, these are applied to six different segments on the chart.
The segment with the value 39.0% is medium blue, which corresponds to 'Std: 0.47' in the legend. The 'Std: 0.94' color (lightest blue) corresponds to the 47.7% segment.
The segment with the value 14.2% has a pale blue inner part, which corresponds to 'Max: 3' in the legend. The segments corresponding to 'Max: 2' are the ones with values 39.0% and 38.0%.
The segment with the value 38.0% has a very light blue inner part, corresponding to 'Max: 2' in the legend. The segment corresponding to 'Max: 3' is the one with the value 14.2%.

The description omits a full account of the chart's segments. For instance, in its description of the 'outer ring', it fails to mention the segments with values 47.7% and 38.0%. In its description of the 'inner ring', it fails to mention that 'Max: 1' applies to four different segments (49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, 5.0%) and that 'Max: 2' applies to two segments (39.0%, 38.0%).
